versions.content: Usage of DataPrototypeTransformationProps in case of a ClientServerOperation If a ClientServerOperation is transported in the ISignal ( callSignal or returnSignal ) the DataPrototypeTransforma- tionProps can be used to assign SOMEIPTransformationProps to a DataPro- totype that is or is part of an ArgumentDataPrototype of the ClientServerOp- eration .
